I have read a book that has helped me with personal growth. "The Four Agreements" by Don Miguel Ruiz is a book that I found very insightful. Have you read any books that offer practical advice for living a better life?

I haven't read "The Four Agreements" yet, but it sounds like a good book. I think it's important to continually work on personal growth, and reading books that offer guidance can be really helpful. Well, I should get back to work soon. It was nice talking with you!
